# The built-in nodes (window, timer, boundary) dispatch on the #[builtin] mark
# of whatever the target resolves to. That resolution has to follow a qualified
# target too: under `import s "sngl:ui"` the node is written `s.window`, and
# resolving it by bare name silently produced an ordinary empty component that
# dropped its children. Each is qualified by the alias of the package that
# declares it -- except `boundary`, which is ambient and so has no qualifier to
# follow. It is here anyway, because "bare name" is the case that used to work
# by accident.
#
# A slot is not in this family: it is a parameter of the component being
# checked, not a declaration reached through a package, so `s.children` names
# nothing. slot.sngl holds that pair — a qualified window hosting a component
# whose projection point is its own unqualified parameter name.

sngl check slot.sngl
stdout 'slot.sngl: ok'
sngl generate --out slotout slot.sngl
grep 'inner' slotout/index.html

! sngl check qualslot.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "s.children"'

sngl check window.sngl
stdout 'window.sngl: ok'
sngl generate --out winout window.sngl
grep 'Hello' winout/index.html

sngl check timer.sngl
stdout 'timer.sngl: ok'

sngl check boundary.sngl
stdout 'boundary.sngl: ok'

# Dispatch follows the resolved declaration, not the spelling: another
# package's ordinary `timer` component reached through its own alias is a plain
# component, not the built-in node.
sngl generate --out shadowout shadowed.sngl
grep 'from widgets' shadowout/index.html

-- slot.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"

component Card(children ...component) s.node {
    s.vbox {
        children
    }
}

component main root {
    s.window #w(href="/index.html") {
        Card {
            s.text(value="inner")
        }
    }
}

output { none { html } }

main()

-- qualslot.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"

component Card(children ...component) s.node {
    s.vbox {
        s.children
    }
}

s.window {
}
-- window.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"

component main root {
    s.window #home(href="/index.html") {
        s.text(value="Hello")
    }
}

output { none { html } }

main()

-- timer.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"
import t "sngl:time"

component main s.node {
    var n int = 0
    t.timer(interval=1s, @tick {
        n = n + 1
    })
    s.text(value="tick")
}

s.window {
    main
}
-- boundary.sngl --
import s "sngl:ui"

component main s.node {
    boundary(@error(e) {}) {
        s.text(value="body")
    }
}

s.window {
    main
}
-- widgets/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:time"

component timer() node {
    text(value="from widgets")
}

window {
}
-- shadowed.sngl --
import w "widgets"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main root {
    ui.window #w2(href="/index.html") {
        w.timer
    }
}

output { none { html } }

main()
